message.translation: 本次会话复用已保留的 Windows GATT 服务。

message.translation: 保留的 Windows BLE 进程已退出，GATT 连续性已丢失。
低功耗蓝牙（Windows，实验性）

message.source: Experimental Windows BLE: enter the phone address and screen dimensions, then connect and pair/connect from the phone. No ADB or USB required; uses the default adapter. Disconnect releases input but retains GATT for the next session while the GUI runs. Stop idle Bluetooth service or Quit ends GATT; phone cache recovery may then be needed.
message.translation: Windows BLE 为实验功能：填写手机地址与屏幕尺寸，点击连接后在手机蓝牙设置中配对或连接。无需 ADB 或 USB，使用默认适配器。点击「断开」释放输入，但在 GUI 运行期间保留 GATT 供下次连接复用；「停止空闲蓝牙服务」或「退出」才注销 GATT，之后可能需要恢复手机缓存。

message.source: Enter the paired phone's Bluetooth LE address as reported by Windows, not the PC adapter address. In BluetoothLE#BluetoothLE<PC>-<phone>, use the final phone address. Identity and pairing are checked online; no arbitrary phone is selected. Stop any standalone BLE prototype or background bridge before connecting.
message.translation: 填写 Windows 报告的已配对手机 Bluetooth LE 地址，不是电脑适配器地址。BluetoothLE#BluetoothLE<电脑>-<手机> 中取最后一段手机地址。程序会在线核对身份及配对状态，不会任意选择手机。连接前请先停止独立 BLE 原型或后台桥接。

message.source: Enter the phone's identity address and screen dimensions. Pair/connect in system Bluetooth settings; no ADB or USB required. Disconnecting retains the resident service.
message.translation: 填写手机身份地址与屏幕尺寸，通过系统蓝牙设置配对或连接，无需 ADB 或 USB。断开会话后常驻服务仍保留。

message.source: Automatic PIN unlock requires the companion app and authorized ADB. If ADB is unavailable, no PIN is sent. Mouse control of the phone is temporarily unavailable during automatic unlocking and resumes when the sequence ends.
message.translation: 自动 PIN 解锁需要新版伴侣应用及已授权的 ADB。ADB 不可用时不会发送 PIN。自动解锁期间暂时无法用鼠标控制手机，解锁流程结束后自动恢复。

message.source: Uses authorized ADB to check the lock state before each entry. If locked, sends wake/Enter, swipes from bottom to top, then sends the PIN and Enter. Mouse movement, clicks and scrolling to the phone are blocked during automatic unlocking and resume when the sequence ends; blocked input is discarded. Requires ADB and absolute mouse mode. PIN is not logged; it is saved per device in local settings.
message.translation: 每次进入前使用已授权 ADB 检查锁屏状态。确认锁定后发送唤醒/回车，从底部向上滑动，再发送 PIN 和回车。自动解锁期间屏蔽发往手机的鼠标移动、点击和滚轮，流程结束后自动恢复；屏蔽期间的操作不会补发。需要 ADB 和绝对坐标模式。PIN 不记录，但会按设备保存到本地设置。
